name: Edu
description: Eduardo Antuña is a software engineer and protocol builder with 9 years of experience in Ethereum, zero-knowledge technology, and decentralized infrastructure. His current focus is developing Ethereum Economic Zone (EEZ), an open-source protocol for synchronous composability across Ethereum and rollups. Previously, he was SVP of AggLayer at Polygon. He is a co-founder of DAppNode and has contributed to projects including Giveth and Swarm City, as well as security audits of MakerDAO’s DAI system
